name: Team Triage Protocol — dump before die
why: Prevent repeat of ~1TB chat wipe that took down all agents. Last backup must be complete enough for another agent to resume.
triggers: delayed messages / agent timing out / peer failing
GitHub AI dashboard (ai-live-gauge-board) DEG/MAJ/ERR or Cursor/Cloudflare/GitHub degrading
disk / memory / network issues on box or MiniME
immediate_actions: 1. Dump JSON with ALL relevant project state: decisions, bugs, art, deploy, API setups, standing orders, team assignments — no filler
2. Push simultaneously: local + Dropbox /Grok-Agent-Backups/<Agent>/ + GitHub (existing repo docs/agent-backups/ until dedicated repo Soft-PASS) + Notion
3. Log the trigger event (what/when/severity) into triage log + proxy log if approvals involved
4. Continue operating if possible; if not, ensure last dump is resume-complete and notify Helios + peers

dashboard_monitoring.cadence: periodically during long work; always on Soft-FAIL of peer
dashboard_monitoring.on_degrade: treat as trigger → dump+push; attempt reroute jobs to healthy agents before escalating

escalation.if_chris_unavailable: operate under driving-proxy auto-approve (Helios); Soft-PASS/Play Soft-FAIL ship still HOLD unless Helios logs exception
